gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-bitter: Tall and open-bowled, Baloo Tamma 2 leads with a lowercase that never snags on a closed-up bowl. And Bitter, a grounded slab-serif, keeps the reading dependable, each s showing a gap you can see through.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-roboto-slab: Tall, open, unmistakable: Baloo Tamma 2 never closes up a bowl. Roboto Slab backs it with precise, structured slab-serif lines where the middle zone dominates and every throat stays open.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-mulish: Baloo Tammudu 2 stands tall, rounded, and open in the e. Mulish, a modern sans-serif with no thick-and-thin modulation at all, sets short ascenders and a large x-height against it.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-roboto-slab: Baloo Tammudu 2 brings tall, rounded lowercase forms and an e that opens up instead of closing its eye. Roboto Slab, precise and structured, keeps that exuberance on a firm footing.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-instrument-sans: Baloo Thambi 2 swells expressively through a deep, distinctive lowercase midsection. Instrument Sans, modern and clean, holds its stroke weight steady, with a minimal step from capital to lowercase.
gen-gf-barriecito-roboto-slab: Ladle-shaped bowls and a big-bodied lowercase: Barriecito is hard to ignore. Roboto Slab, a precise and structured slab-serif, gives it a steady foil, its middle zone dominating each line.
gen-gf-battambang-inter: Battambang is a display face with compressed ascenders and open jaws on every curved stroke, distinctive and expressive. Inter, a smooth sans, lets its big counters breathe down each tube-like line.
gen-gf-battambang-mulish: Mulish draws a single flat line weight through every glyph, with apertures like a horseshoe magnet's open end. Battambang, compressed and open-jawed, supplies all the drama while Mulish stays flat.
gen-gf-battambang-poppins: Compressed ascenders and open-jawed curves: that's Battambang making an entrance. Poppins does the opposite job, keeping loose, knot-free curves and a tall, sturdy lowercase body steady from stem to terminal.
gen-gf-battambang-rubik: Rubik, clean and soft, makes its lowercase look big next to capitals, with open round forms that read clearly at small sizes. Battambang adds compressed, open-jawed flair on top of that.
